notes: even so at t016–t017 stays whole on οὕτως under rules 82 and 100, no καί standing in the verse to claim the even.
The three substantival articles take the pronouns they, she and they under rule 22, no participle following any of them.
ἐστιν is expressed, so the supplied subject It rides with it under rule 9; rule 68 is not in question, speaking only of a verbless clause.
